title: Fallen house
description:
Set on rural land within an agricultural and forested property near Abrantes, this single-family house is located on a site that already contained built pre-existing structures used to support the activities carried out on the land.

The force lines defined by these existing elements—whose preservation was a requirement of the client—guided an architectural solution that is both innovative and functional, with the design emerging directly from a careful reading of the site.

The formal strategy is based on the idea of a portion of the house appearing to ‘give way’ to the terrain, while the remaining volume is held above a dark base corresponding to the ground floor. This gesture strengthens the relationship between architecture and topography, giving the project a strong conceptual identity.

The architectural reading results from a balanced composition of solid volumes and oblique planes, contrasted with the discipline of a restrained white body punctuated by precise openings. The outcome is an expressive architectural language in which tension and balance coexist harmoniously.
